facts.text: Maria tried surfing for the first time during her vacation and found it exciting despite falling off repeatedly.

evidence.quote: Yeah, I did! I tried my hand at surfing for the first time- it was so exciting! Even though I kept falling off, it taught me the power of not giving up and trying new things.

facts.text: Maria believes that trying new things teaches the power of not giving up and helps in personal growth.

evidence.quote: Even though I kept falling off, it taught me the power of not giving up and trying new things.

facts.text: John encourages Maria to keep up the courage and acknowledges the value of trying new things.

evidence.quote: Wow Maria, that's awesome! Trying new things takes guts and it can be so rewarding. Keep up the courage!

facts.text: Maria agrees with John that challenging oneself is important for growth and self-exploration.

evidence.quote: Pushing boundaries is how we grow and find out what we're really capable of. It's a journey of self-exploration, it can be hard but it's so worth it.
